intro: Taming the Beast is the foundational rite of passage for young tauren hunters in Bloodhoof Village. Guided by trainer Yaw Sharpmane, the hunter ventures into Mulgore to tame an adult plainstrider, taking the first step toward forging a spiritual bond with the creatures of the Earthmother.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a tauren, it is important to follow the traditions of our ancestors by fighting mighty creatures. By besting these creatures, we are able to intake their spirits, allowing us to become closer to the Earthmother.

In the same way, taming a beast to fight alongside us helps us become one with nature around us. Eventually, you will learn to tame a beast of your choosing. But all things take practice, and you have much to learn. Begin by taking this taming rod; you must tame an adult plainstrider.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Practice your skills, friend. Tame the adult plainstrider.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Signs have appeared to me from the Earthmother; you have done well.
